headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: PER (9)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix from pole position, 18.0s ahead of Charles Leclerc, with George Russell completing the podium.
Sergio Perez made the biggest climb, from P9 to P4.
Nico Hulkenberg had a day to forget, dropping from P8 to P15.
The stewards penalised PER (5 second time penalty).
There were 37 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 290 points over Sergio Perez.
